chunks: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.

key_terms.أَمِينٌ: Trusted, trustworthy, one who is reliable and truthful
key_terms.رَسُولٌ: Messenger, one sent with a divine message

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet mean when he calls himself a trusted messenger?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine selection of the Prophet as an 'Amin' (trustworthy), linking his moral integrity to the infallibility (Ismah) that qualifies him to convey revelation without error. It serves as a foundational proof for his authority, contrasting his trustworthy mission with the skepticism of the disbelievers who questioned his prophethood.
